q.prompt: How many pets has Kim got?

captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 2. In this lesson: Pets.
Name pets and say what they can and can't do.
Here are some new words. Rabbit. A small animal with long ears. Parrot.
A bird that can copy words. Tortoise. A slow animal with a hard shell.
Listen and say them. rabbit
parrot
tortoise.
And some more words. Hamster. A small furry pet that lives in a cage. Fur.
The soft hair on an animal. Cage. A box with bars for a pet. Listen and say them.
hamster
fur
cage.
Time for a question. The video will stop.
Which word means: a small animal with long ears?
Now some grammar: can and can't. Use ‘can’ when someone is able to do something.
Use ‘can't’ (cannot) when they are not able to. For example: A bird can fly.
For example: A fish can't walk.
Now listen, and read along. Kim's pets. Kim has got three pets. Pip is a parrot.
He is green. He can fly and he can say ‘Hello!’ Toby is a tortoise. He is old and slow.
He can't run, but he can swim. Fluff is a hamster. She has got soft brown fur.
She sleeps all day!
Another question. The video will stop. How many pets has Kim got?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like rabbit, parrot, tortoise.
You practised can and can't. And you read Kim's pets. Now try the practice questions.
See you next time!

captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 2. In this lesson: Wild animals.
Use describing words for wild animals and answer riddles.
Here are some new words. Lion. A big wild cat that roars. Elephant.
A very big animal with a long trunk. Monkey. An animal that climbs trees.
Listen and say them. lion
elephant
monkey.
And some more words. Crocodile. A long animal with big teeth that lives in rivers.
Tall. Very high from the bottom to the top. Strong. Able to lift heavy things.
Listen and say them. crocodile
tall
strong.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: a big wild cat that roars?
Now some grammar: Describing words (adjectives).
Describing words tell us more about a noun. They usually go before the noun.
For example: a big elephant For example: a tall giraffe
Now listen, and read along. Who am I? I am very big and grey.
I have got big ears and a long trunk. Who am I? I am an elephant! I live in trees.
I have got a long tail. I love bananas. Who am I? I am a monkey! I am green and long.
I swim in the river. I have got lots of sharp teeth. Who am I? I am a crocodile!
Another question. The video will stop. Which animal is big and grey?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like lion, elephant, monkey.
You practised describing words (adjectives). And you read Who am I?
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!
